newsitem.title: UK: Argos shares fall after trading statement.
newsitem.headline: Argos shares fall after trading statement.

text.p: Shares in Argos Plc were sharply lower in pre-market trade on Friday after the group reported lower than expected second half sales and said annual profits were unlikely to exceed analysts worst expectations.
The shares were indicated 60-1/2p lower at 672-1/2p by 0812 GMT.

The company said in a trading update that sales over the Christmas period had risen by four percent on a like-for-like basis. But on the whole, second half sales growth of just over six percent was lower than in the first half of the year and failed to meet with expectations.
Adding to the gloom with a profits warning, the company said annual pretax profits were unlikely to exceed 140 million stg. Analysts had been expecting profits in the range of 140-156 million stg.
